goal: Integration happens automatically when a verdict passes under a policy that only a human can change.
why: The per-push human approval is the last manual step.
acceptance: integrates only with zero surviving mutations and a green suite
only fast-forward or merge commit to the one integration ref; never force
dry-run mode shows what would be pushed
the policy cannot be changed by an agent (protected or signed)
an automatic revert of an integrated change is proven before enabling
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan
